# Marketplace publication

The root of `BenLewies/Accent` now contains the single plugin manifest, README,
license and preview. Submit this repository, not a second extracted plugin repo.

See ../../docs/MARKETPLACE_SUBMISSION.md for the prepared body and
../../docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md for remaining publication gates. Keep the repository
private until its owner authorizes visibility change. Submit only after the owner
has approved the exact body and all checklist statements are true.
